notes.subject: 400 yia vs foapela kain man
notes.rationale: Ves 13 i tok foa handet yia, hia i tok namba foa kain man — plandi translator i skelim wanem pasin (Ex 12:40 i gat 430 yia; ol kain man long bihain i kirap kwik).

notes.subject: namba foa kain man
notes.rationale: Namba bilong ol kain man — ol man bilong namba foa senis bai kam bek.

notes.subject: rong i no pinis yet
notes.rationale: Yahwe i save lukim wanem taim rong bilong ol Amori bai pilap — dispela i samting i stap hait yet long man.

notes.subject: הנה ... הנה
notes.rationale: Tupela 'hia' — ples bilong kam bek na taim bilong nau; wanpela tok Hibru i wokim tupela sans.

translation: Na long namba foa ol man bilong olgeta kain, ol bai kam bek hia; bilong wanem rong bilong ol Amori i no yet i kamap pinis, i go inap hia.

tokens.gloss: na long ol man bilong olgeta kain
